## Summary

## Verification

- [ ] `testDebugUnitTest` passed
- [ ] `lintDebug` passed with warnings treated as errors
- [ ] `assembleDebug` passed
- [ ] D-pad/focus behavior was tested when UI behavior changed
- [ ] Physical playback was tested when media behavior changed, or marked not tested below
- [ ] Test data, screenshots, logs, and diagnostics contain no real server data or secrets
